tei:div.tei:p: 213)༄༅/ bla ma dgongs 'dus bskang mchog 'don 'grigs bzhugs/

214)༄༅/ bla ma dgongs 'dus bskang mchog 'don 'grigs ni/ bca' shom zur gsal ltar la/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= ma dang*/ mchod phreng las/ oṃ shud+dhe= nas lce lag rdor dril byin brlab/ hūm̐ āḥ bar/ bya khyung mchod pa byin rlabs/ spos phyung/ mngon rtogs las/ mdun gyi nam mkha'= nas/ bzhugs par dmigs: bar/ tshangs sgra las/ oṃ na mo hūm̐: nas/ ngang la nas: mngon rtogs las na mo:rkang gnyis= nas/ myur thob shog: bar/ mchod phreng las/ na mo:rkang gnyis= nas/ btson par gyi: bar/ tshangs sgra las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nas/ pha la āḥ bar/ chog sgrigs las/ sems can thams cad= sogs nas/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: mngon rtogs nas/ oṃ ma hā shu dz+nyā ta= nas/ srung sngags lan gsum/ rdul du rlog par bsam: tshangs sgra las / hūm̐ hrī: sa bon= sogs nas/ satwa āḥ yan/ sman raka byin rlabs spro na mchod sprin ltar/ hūm̐:lha tshogs mchod pa'i= nas/ sa ma ya hūm̐ swa hā: yan bya/ bsdu na tshangs sgra rang gzhung ltar 'don/ hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs 215) nas/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: bar/ mdun skyed rgyas par mngon rtogs las/ bdag nyid rgyu'i he ru ka= nas/ gar byed pa'o: bar/ bsdu na rtse le'i mdun skyed/ oṃ swa bhā= nas/ tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ yan dang*/ nyon mongs sreg byed las/ pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi thugs= zhes pa nas/ khros pa'i cha lugs can no: bar/ bum skyed ni bya khyung ltar/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa= sogs nas/ zur gsal sbyar/ bzhugs par gyur: las thams cad= nas/ tshul du gsal ba'o: bar/ dung zhal gyi chu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma= sogs nas/ ldan pa zhig tu gyur: bar/ mngon rtogs las/ de ltar gsal ba'i= nas/ rgyud bskul= bar/ tshangs sgra'i spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ hrī: nub phyogs bde ba can= nas/ ga ṇa tsakra kha hī: bar/ bya khyung las khā hi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru= dang*/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud= nas/ zhal du ma ha pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/

ma hā rak+ṣa khā hi: ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi: zhes kha sgyur 'gres/ chos sku= sogs/ shin tu rnal 'byor= zhes pa'i mtshams su 216) gtso dgu'i sngags la'ang*/ khā hi: sbyar/ khyad par du'ang bde gshegs= sogs nas/ bka' srung yan/ bstod pa rgyas pa bstod 'bum ltar/ hūm̐ hrī: zla gam dbang chen= nas/ thugs dam can rnams bstod: bar/ 'og gi dus gsum bde shegs= nas/ gar sgyur mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ gong gi hūm̐ hrī: bla ma rnams= nas/ 'dus rgya mtsho= yan sh+lau ka gcig 'og gi dad cing gdung ba= nas/ slob par shog: bar/ bsdu na tshangs sgra'i gzhung bstod/ hūm̐ hrī: chos kyi dbyings las= nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ maṇ+ḍal ltar gsol 'debs/ hrī: nub phyogs= nas/ bsdus pa dang*/ gang ltar yang*/ dus gsum gyi bla ma= nas/ mdzad du gsol: bar/ 'jab dgongs las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ skul lo skul lo= nas/ mdzad du gsol/ bar/ gong gi bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi thugs kyi rtse mo gyen la bstan pa'i tsit+ta mchong gur rmug po gur phub pa lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su pad+ma dmar po hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa de'i phyi rol du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru de ba wīki ni sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas bskor ba 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin zla ba nya rgyas pa lta bu'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ de'i mtha' bskor du yig 'bru rnams skar ma'i phreng ba ltar bkra lam mer bskor ba la mdun phyogs yi ge oṃ nas g.yas skor du 217) klog pa'i tshul gyis= bar dang*/ 'og gi hūm̐ hrī: pho brang dbus nas= nas/ mi gtong: bar/ rtsa sngags bzla/ pho brang shar phyogs bud+dha thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs kyi= sogs nas/ 'khor lo dkar po oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa= nas/ 'od dkar po'i rang bzhin zla ba= sogs dang*/ 'og gi dzab skul/ hūm̐ hrī: pho brang shar nas= snyen pa dang*/ de'i 'gres gtso bo thams cad la sbyar te/

pho brang lho phyogs mi skyod rdo rje'i= rin po che ser po traṃ ser pos mtshan pa= 'od ser po'i rang bzhin= pho brang nub phyogs pad+ma dbang chen rtsal gyi= pad+ma dmar po hriḥdamar pos mtshan pa= 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin= pho brang byang phyogs rig 'dzin thod 'chang rtsal gyi= rdo rje rgya gram āḥljang gus mtshan pa/ 'od ljang gu'i rang bzhin= pho brang shar lho mdog dmar me phreng gi= gser gyi mchod rne bum par hūm̐ dmar pos mtshan pa= 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin= pho brang lho nub sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i= gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar hūṃ mthing gas mtshan pa/ 'od thing nag gi rang bzhin= pho brang nub byang dpal chen rta mgrin gyi= be con dmar po hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa= 'od dmar nag gi rang bzhin= pho brang byang shar lag na rdo rje'i= rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa= 'od sngon po'i rang bzhin= zhes pa rnams kha bsgyur/ byang shar ky-i sngags bzla zin nas/ phyi 'khor dzab dmigs ni/ sgo mtshams dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang rang gi srog yig gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags 218)kyis g.yon bskor du bskor ba bdag skyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od gyi bskul bas sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran te phrin las thogs pa med par sgrub par mos: hūm̐ hrī: dkyil 'khor chen po'i= sogs dang*/ phyi 'khor skyong ba= nas/ dam bca' 'o: bar/ bka' sdod sngags bzla/ gong gi bdag nyid lha yi= nas/ tshur 'khor ba dang: yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa rnams rang nyid yab kyi= nas/ 'khor lor dmigs: bar/ las byang tshangs sgra'i dzab skul/ hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod= nas/ bsgrub par bya: bar/ spyi dril 'bring po bzla/ mngon rtogs las/ lha tshogs gtso 'khor= nas/ 'grub par 'gyur: bar/ dzab dgongs las/ hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings mtha' dbus= nas sku gsum tshang bar/

spyi dril chen mo bzla/ gong gi rigs drug gnas sbyong*/ bdag nyid lha yi= nas le tshan gnyis/ sgrog par bsam: spyi dril chen mo bzla/ bung ba tshang zhig gi dmigs pa/ bdag nyid lha'i= nas/ sgrog par bsamaḥ bar/ bum snyen ka la sha snyen/ 219) las bum snyen dmigs/ las bum gyi lha'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dmar po'i= nas/ gang bar gyur: las sngags snyen/ dung zhal gyi khro bo'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi= sngags bzla/ dzab dgongs las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam= nas/ dhā ki ni hūm̐: rtse ler/ bum lha 'od du zhu nas= sogs/ mdzad du gsol: bar/ a li/ kā li/ yig brgya/ ye dhar/ tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐: ye shes lha tshogs= dang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ zhi ba lhun gyi grub= nas/ las mdzod cig: bar/ dge bsngo bcas/ slar mdun skyed la dmigs te mngon rtogs las/ hūm̐ hrī: phyogs dus mkha' klong= nas/ at+ma ko3 haṃ: bar/ tse le'i khrus gsol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas= nas/ la ye s+t+waṃ: bar/ nyon mongs sreg byed las/ rang gi lus= sangs sangs dag par bsam: bar/ phyag 'tshal brgya rtsa/ e ma hoḥsangs rgyas kun dngos= nas/ gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: dang*/ zhi khro'i phyag 'tshal/ chos rnams rnam dag= tshang bar 'don/ mchod phreng las/ bdud rtsi 'jam legs= sogs sho lo ka gnyis sngags bcas/ mngon rtogs las/ me tog bdug spos= nas/ sa ma ye hūm̐: bar/ phyag 'tshal las/ 220) oṃ āḥhūm̐:phyogs bcu'i= nas/ yongs rdzogs shog: bar/ maṇ+ḍal/ yig brgya dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi= sogs nas tshig lhug dang 'og gi tshig bcad spel nas/ sa ma ye hūm̐: bar/ mchod phreng las/ rgyal ba sras dang= rgyal srid= rin chen gdugs mdzes= sogs rtags brgyad dang*/ mngon rtogs las/ hoḥdabang po rnam lnga= nas/ āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bar/ mchod sprin las/ rang byung gdod nas= nas/ ka ma la ya s+t+wam̐: bar/ mngon rtogs kyi/ gtor mgron gyi lha tshogs= sogs sngags bsngos mthar/ chog bsgrigs/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud= nas/

shin tu rnal 'byor= mtshams su gtso dgu'i sngags la/ ba ling ta= sbyar/ khyad par du= nas bka' srung yan/ mngon rtogs las/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= nas/ 'grub mdzad gsol: bar sman raka ltar/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma= sogs tshig gis bsngo ba dang*/ hūm̐ hrī: phyi nang gsang ba'i= nas/ kha raṃ khā hi: mngon rtogs nas/ hūm̐ hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas= nas/ 'grub par shog: bar/ sman raka bshams nas/ dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyis ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin du gtor mas dgyes shing tshim par 221)gyur cig: zhes kha bsgyur/ gong gi sangs rgyas kyi bden pa= nas/ gyur cig: bar/ bstod pa rgyas pa tshangs sgra' ི/ hūm̐ hrī: chos kyi dbyings las= nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ bsdu na mngon rtogs ltar/ hūm̐ hrī: bde chen= sogs nas bstod pa/ bar/ nyon mongs sreg byed las/ rang nyid tha mal du= nas/ spyan drangs: bar/ mchod phreng las/ badz+ra sa mā dza: nas/ dbu brgyan par bsam: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa sa pā ri bā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra titsh+tsha= sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas= nas/ khyed phyag 'tshal: bar/ skong chog ltar/ rdo rje sems pa'i thugs kar= sogs/ yig brgya dang gzhung sngags sbrel nas bzla/ mthar bcom ldan 'das= nas/ bzhag par bya'o: 'di ltar bkram pa'i= nas/ thob pa'i slad du: bar/ phyag 'tshal ltar/ ho:dgongs su gsol= nas/ grub par shog: bar/ maṇ+ḍal mjug gi smon lam gsum spro na gtang*/ bka' srung rta nag gi mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ bstod pa yan/ sha za/ btsan rog dag kyang skyed chog nas bstod pa'i bar/ tshangs sgra'i tshogs/ e ma ho= nas/ rdzas su gyur: bar/ 222) mngon rtogs las/ tshogs snod 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi= nas/ bslad med pa ltar gyur: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: nas/ ha ho hrīḥ bar/ nyon mongs sreg byed las/ stong gsum 'di'am= nas/ mar me 'bul ba yan/ mar me'i smon lam yang gtang*/

tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrī: bla med= sogs kyi tshogs 'bul/ bsgral bstab mchod bshags skong ba yan/ mdangs skong chen mo mthar chags su gtang/ rta nag sha za'i skong ba phrin bcol sbrel/ btsan skong bcas/ tshangs sgra'i tshogs drang ba/ lhag ma/ hūm̐ hrī: chos sku skye med= nas/ rgyu 'bras gcig: bar/ bya khyung ltar lhag ma byin brlab/ ya rkan yab= nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: e āḥral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrī: dpal gyi bka' nyan= nas/ swa hā: bar/ skong chog las/ dngos po chos nyid= sogs/ aṃ aṃ aṃ: bar/ nub rnams su/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ tshangs sgra'i chad mdo/ brtan ma/ bro mnan gyi/ spyod par shog: bar/ mngon rtogs las/ hrī: bde bar gshegs= nas/ sid+dhi hrī: bar/ yang na/ phyag 'tshal brgya rtsa'i mchod pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyogs bcu'i= 223) nas/ yongs rdzogs shog: bar/ bstod 'bum gsham gyi/ dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs= nas/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ bde mchog bde spyod= sogs nas/ ho: bar/ 'og tu/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= nas/ grol bar shog: bar/ maṇ+ḍal smon lam gsum sngar ma song na 'dir bya/ tshangs sgra'i/ bdag cag ma rig= yig brgya lan gsum gong du/ e ma ho: dus gsum sangs rgyas= sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ a li/ ka li/ rten snying lan gsum/ rten bzhugs/ mngon rtogs las/ srung ba'i 'khor lor= nas/ brdal bar bya'o: maṇ+ḍal bsngo ba gsum/ mngon rtogs las/ kun bzang yab yum= nas/ zhi bar shog: bar/ tshangs sgra'i/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel= nas/ e ma ho: bar/ rgyal dkyil mas legs par grub bo/ grol nyin snga nub/ dngos po chos nyid= tshar nas/ tshangs sgra'i bstod pa/ skye med chos dbyings= nas/ bstsal du gsol: bar/ chad tho'i mgor tshangs sgra'i gzhung bskul gtang*/ grol nyin/ dngos po chos nyid= zin nas/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ bskul 'bum ltar/ hūm̐:ma g.yel ma g.yel= nas/ 'grub par mdzod:

bar/ 'dir rta nag skul pa btang nas/ hūm̐:sangs rgyas bstan= nas/ mchis par mdzod: 224) bar/ tshangs sgra'i chad tho dang*/ gong du/ hūm̐ hrī: gdod nas rnam dag= nas/ chem la phob: bar/ rta mgrin las/ hrī: dbang chen 'bar ba= nas/ med par mdzod: bar dang*/ tshangs sgra'i/ bla ma yi dam= nas/ 'grub par mdzod: bar/ 'og gi brtan ma/ bro mnan rjes/ me phreng ltar mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ dngos su 'byor gshams= nas/ kha kha khā hi khā hi: bar/ dkyil 'khor dgu rdzogs= kyis bstod/ mngon rtogs las/ hrīḥ bde bar gshegs= sogs nas/ sid+dhi hrīḥ bar/ tshangs sgra'i dngos grub/ bde mchog bde spyod= nas/ hoḥ bar/ 'og gi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= nas/ grol bar shog: bar/ rta mgrin las/ gang yang bdag blo= dang*/ las byang gi bdag cag ma rig= yig brgya bcas/ rta mgrin las/ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings las= nas/ bstsal du gsol: bar/ las byang gi bkra shis dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis gang 'os/ brtan zhugs/ mngon rtogs las/ srung ba'i 'khor lor= nas/ bdal bar bya'o/ de nas dkar gtor dang*/ gser skyems/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ aḥhūm̐: tshangs sgra'i/ hūm̐ hrī: 'das dus= nas/ grogs mdzod cig: bar/ maṇ+ḍal/ mngon rtogs/ las byang gsum gyi bsngo ba bya'o/ 225) yang skong chog nyin rdzogs bya na cho ga'i khog de ltar chad lhag med par tshang dgos la/ sman raka byin rlabs gzhung zur gang byed dal khom dang bstun/ mngon rtogs tse le ltar/ bstod 'bum nges par gtang*/ mdun skyed skabs tshangs sgra'i bstod pa dang bde rol gnyis ka gtang*/ tshogs rjes dngos po chos nyid mtshams gzhung bstod skye med chos dbyings/ long khyab yod tshe skul 'bum/ brel skabs gzhung skul kho nas 'thus/ de man chad grol nyin ltar la/ mchod bstod skabs kyi mchod pa phyag 'tshal brgya rtsa'i nang des 'thus so// zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung las btus pa dge'o// 226)
